Classification Neural Network Learner

Source: R/learner_deepnet_classif_nnTrain.R
mlr_learners_classif.nnTrain.Rd

Calls deepnet::nn.train() from deepnet.

Initial parameter values

  • output is set to "softmax" for probabilistic classification.

Dictionary

This Learner can be instantiated via lrn():

lrn("classif.nnTrain")

Meta Information

  • Task type: “classif”

  • Predict Types: “response”, “prob”

  • Feature Types: “integer”, “numeric”

  • Required Packages: mlr3, mlr3extralearners, deepnet

Parameters

IdTypeDefaultLevelsRange
activationfuncharactersigmsigm, linear, tanh-
batchsizeinteger100\([1, \infty)\)
hiddenuntyped10L-
hidden_dropoutnumeric0\([0, 1]\)
initBuntyped--
initWuntyped--
learningratenumeric0.8\([0, \infty)\)
learningrate_scalenumeric1\([0, \infty)\)
max_number_of_layersinteger-\([1, \infty)\)
momentumnumeric0.5\([0, \infty)\)
numepochsinteger3\([1, \infty)\)
outputcharacter-sigm, linear, softmax-
visible_dropoutnumeric0\([0, 1]\)

References

Rong, Xiao (2022). “deepnet: Deep Learning Toolkit in R.” R package version 0.2.1. doi:10.32614/CRAN.package.deepnet . https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=deepnet.

Arguments

Whether to make a deep clone.

Examples

# Define the Learner
learner = lrn("classif.nnTrain")
print(learner)
#> 
#> ── <LearnerClassifNNTrain> (classif.nnTrain): Training Neural Network by Backpro
#> • Model: -
#> • Parameters: output=softmax
#> • Packages: mlr3, mlr3extralearners, and deepnet
#> • Predict Types: [response] and prob
#> • Feature Types: integer and numeric
#> • Encapsulation: none (fallback: -)
#> • Properties: multiclass and twoclass
#> • Other settings: use_weights = 'error', predict_raw = 'FALSE'

# Define a Task
task = tsk("sonar")

# Create train and test set
ids = partition(task)

# Train the learner on the training ids
learner$train(task, row_ids = ids$train)

print(learner$model)
